name: FullEnrich
summary: Waterfall enrichment of work emails, personal emails and mobile phones across 20+ providers, plus people and company search and reverse email lookup.

api_key.description: A FullEnrich API key (app.fullenrich.com/app/api). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: 60 API calls per minute across all endpoints; enrich and reverse lookup take up to 100 contacts per call, with 100 concurrent enrichments per workspace.
Credits are spent only when something is found; see each endpoint's notes for the price.
Enrichment data is kept 3 months (GDPR); fetch results within that window.
Sub-account and bring-your-own-key management endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credits the API key can spend now, capped by any consumption limit on the key.

endpoints.name: Check the API key
endpoints.summary: Whether the API key is valid.

endpoints.name: Start a contact enrichment
endpoints.summary: Waterfall search for work emails, personal emails and mobile phones of up to 100 contacts; answers with an enrichment_id.

name.description: A readable name for the enrichment, shown in the dashboard.

data.description: Contacts, up to 100: {first_name, last_name, domain, company_name, linkedin_url, enrich_fields, custom}. enrich_fields takes contact.work_emails, contact.personal_emails, contact.phones.

silentFail.description: Skip contacts with invalid or missing input instead of failing the whole request.

notes: Spends credits only on results: 1 per work email found, 3 per personal email, 10 per mobile phone (custom plans may differ). Re-enriching the same input within 3 months costs 0.
Asynchronous: poll fullenrich.contact.enrich_result with the enrichment_id.
The example contact is FullEnrich's free test contact; it costs 0 credits only with exactly that data.

endpoints.name: Get enrichment results
endpoints.summary: Status and found contact data of an enrichment.

enrichment_id.description: The id returned when the enrichment started.

forceResults.description: Return what was found so far even if the enrichment is not finished; not recommended for regular use.

notes: Results are kept 3 months; an older enrichment_id errors.

endpoints.name: Start a reverse email lookup
endpoints.summary: Find the person and company behind up to 100 email addresses; answers with an id to poll.

name.description: A readable name for the lookup, shown in the dashboard.

silentFail.description: Skip empty or invalid emails instead of failing the whole request.

notes: 1 credit per email whose owner is found.
Asynchronous: poll fullenrich.contact.reverse_email_result with the returned id.

endpoints.name: Get reverse email lookup results
endpoints.summary: Person and company found for each email of a reverse lookup.

enrichment_id.description: The id returned when the reverse lookup started.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: People matching company, title, seniority, function, location, skill and tenure filters.

offset.description: Results to skip, at most 10,000; use search_after beyond that.

search_after.description: Cursor: the search_after value from the previous answer.

current_position_titles.description: Current job titles. Each filter is a list of {value, exclude, exact_match} objects (ranges such as headcounts take {min, max, exclude}); values in one field combine with AND.

current_position_seniority_level.description: Seniority, e.g. Owner, Founder, C-level, VP, Director, Manager.

current_position_job_functions.description: Job functions, e.g. Sales, Software & Data.

person_locations.description: City, region or country of the person.

notes: A read over POST. Synchronous. 0.25 credit per person returned; people already exported once cost nothing again.

More filters exist (past companies and titles, technologies, universities, tenure, days since job change); see the docs. Each filter is a list of {value, exclude, exact_match} objects (ranges such as headcounts take {min, max, exclude}); values in one field combine with AND.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies matching name, domain, industry, keyword, technology, location, headcount and founding-year filters.

offset.description: Results to skip, at most 10,000; use search_after beyond that.

search_after.description: Cursor: the search_after value from the previous answer.

names.description: Company names. Each filter is a list of {value, exclude, exact_match} objects (ranges such as headcounts take {min, max, exclude}); values in one field combine with AND.

types.description: Company types, e.g. Public Company, Privately Held.

notes: A read over POST. 0.25 credit per company returned; companies already exported once cost nothing again.

endpoints.name: Look up one person
endpoints.summary: The best matching person profile by LinkedIn URL or id, or by full name plus a company identifier.

person_name.description: Full name; send with a company identifier.

company_domain.description: Domain of the person's company, to disambiguate a name.

company_professional_network_url.description: LinkedIn URL of the person's company.

company_professional_network_id.description: LinkedIn id of the person's company.

notes: A read over POST. Priced as Search (per person returned). Returns a profile, not emails or phones: use fullenrich.contact.enrich for those.

endpoints.name: Look up one company
endpoints.summary: The best matching company by domain or LinkedIn URL or id.
notes: A read over POST. Priced as Search.
